scope: Read-only original provider semantic FK DDL and sanitized cumulative SQL fingerprint metadata; no raw statement SQL, private member records, credentials, live SQL changes or publication

numeric_evidence.sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_exec_time DESC,s.queryid) AS ordinal,s.queryid::text AS queryid,r.rolname AS role_name,s.calls,round(s.mean_exec_time::numeric,3) AS mean_ms,round(s.total_exec_time::numeric,1) AS total_ms,round(s.max_exec_time::numeric,1) AS max_ms,s.shared_blks_hit,s.shared_blks_read,s.temp_blks_written,s.temp_blks_read,s.rows,CASE WHEN ltrim(s.query) ILIKE 'WITH%' THEN 'WITH' WHEN ltrim(s.query) ILIKE 'SELECT%' THEN 'SELECT' WHEN ltrim(s.query) ILIKE 'INSERT%' THEN 'INSERT' WHEN ltrim(s.query) ILIKE 'UPDATE%' THEN 'UPDATE' WHEN ltrim(s.query) ILIKE 'DELETE%' THEN 'DELETE' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS kind,lower((regexp_match(s.query,'dic_[a-z0-9_]+','i'))[1]) AS dic_identifier FROM pg_stat_statements s LEFT JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=s.userid WHERE s.calls>0), selected AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE ordinal BETWEEN 241 AND 320) SELECT jsonb_build_object('observed_at',now(),'stats_reset',(SELECT stats_reset FROM pg_stat_statements_info),'total_active_fingerprints',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE calls>0),'selected',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(selected) ORDER BY ordinal) FROM selected)) AS evidence

fk_source_review.sql: SELECT jsonb_build_object('observed_at',now(),'count',count(*),'fks',jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'table',c.relname,'fk',fk.conname,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(fk.oid,true),'referenced_table',fk.confrelid::regclass::text,'estimated_rows',c.reltuples,'stats_live_rows',s.n_live_tup,'stats_seq_scan',s.seq_scan,'stats_idx_scan',s.idx_scan,'indexes',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',ic.relname,'definition',pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid),'columns',i.indkey::text,'unique',i.indisunique,'scan_count',si.idx_scan) ORDER BY ic.relname) FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid=i.indexrelid LEFT JOIN pg_stat_user_indexes si ON si.indexrelid=i.indexrelid WHERE i.indrelid=c.oid)) ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname,fk.conname)) AS evidence FROM pg_constraint fk JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=fk.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_stat_user_tables s ON s.relid=c.oid WHERE n.nspname='private' AND fk.contype='f' AND fk.conname IN ('admin_access_events_actor_id_fkey','admin_access_events_member_id_fkey','admin_content_edits_actor_id_fkey','admin_content_edits_subject_owner_id_fkey','dic_admin_account_delete_operations_actor_id_fkey','dic_coffee_audit_coffee_id_fkey','dic_coffee_audit_submission_id_fkey','dic_coffee_first_entry_first_submission_id_fkey','dic_member_approval_deliveries_member_id_fkey','dic_roaster_aliases_roaster_id_fkey','dic_signup_review_events_actor_id_fkey','dic_signup_review_events_member_id_fkey','dic_source_attempts_owner_id_fkey','import_control_owner_only_exception_owner_id_fkey')

drift.sql: WITH app AS (SELECT n.nspname,p.oid,p.proname,pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) AS def FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','private')) SELECT jsonb_build_object('observed_at',now(),'function_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM app),'function_ordered_md5',(SELECT md5(string_agg(nspname||'.'||proname||'='||md5(def),';' ORDER BY nspname,proname,oid)) FROM app),'views',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','private') AND c.relkind IN ('v','m')),'tables',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','private') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p')),'policies',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname IN ('public','private')),'migrations',(SELECT count(*) FROM supabase_migrations.schema_migrations),'legacy_directory',(SELECT to_regclass('private.dic_roaster_directory')::text),'legacy_aliases',(SELECT to_regclass('private.dic_roaster_aliases')::text)) AS evidence
